title: Demo, the account room band
round: Shape of the account room card
asks: When this account nears its limit, the band names the account with more room. Only the card's shape changes between options.
measurement: Same words, colours and buttons in all three. Dark terminal, laptop width.

variants.name: Boxed
variants.why: The three lines inside a rounded box, so they read as one thing to deal with.

variants.name: Ruled
variants.why: A rule down the left edge groups the lines without closing them in.

variants.name: Bare
variants.why: No edge at all, so the amber lead alone says where the card starts.
